actions.name: Awe-Inspiring Gaze
actions.desc: The planetar targets a creature within 90 feet. The target makes a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is frightened until the end of its next turn. If the target makes its saving throw, it is immune to any angels Awe-Inspiring Gaze for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Flaming Sword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 21 (6d6) ongoing fire or radiant damage (the planetars choice). A creature can use an action to extinguish this holy flame on itself or a creature within 5 feet.

actions.name: Heal
actions.desc: The planetar touches a creature other than itself  magically healing 60 hit points of damage and ending any blindness  curse  deafness  disease  or poison on the target.

actions.name: Heavenly Bolt
actions.desc: The planetar fires a lightning bolt in a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line makes a Dexterity saving throw  taking 56 (16d6) lightning damage on a failed save  or half damage on a success.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The planetar attacks twice with its flaming sword.

actions.name: Protective Parry
actions.desc: When a creature within 5 feet would be hit with a melee attack, the planetar applies disadvantage to the attack roll.

traits.name: Champion of Truth
traits.desc: The planetar automatically detects lies. Additionally, it cannot lie.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The planetars spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 20). The planetar can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
- **1/Day Each:** Commune, Control Weather, Raise Dead

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 21 (4d6+7) slashing damage plus 31 (7d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Healing Touch
actions.desc: The planetar touches another creature. The target magically regains 30 (6d8+3) HP and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The planetar makes two Greatsword attacks, or it makes three Radiant Bolt attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting. If two Greatsword or Radiant Bolt attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 19 CON save or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Radiant Bolt
actions.desc: _Ranged Spell Attack:_ +11 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 33 (6d8+6) radiant damage.

actions.name: Radiant Burst
actions.desc: A pulse of divine power ripples out from the planetar's golden halo. Each hostile creature within 15 feet of the planetar must make a DC 19 DEX save, taking 56 (16d6) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Each friendly creature within 15 feet of the planetar is empowered with divine energy and has advantage on all melee attack rolls it makes before the start of the planetar's next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The planetar casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using CHA as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19).

- **At Will:** _command_, _invisibility_ (self only)
- **3/Day Each:** _daylight_, _raise dead_ (as an action)

traits.name: Angelic Resilience
traits.desc: The planetar is resistant to radiant damage and to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. In addition, it is immune to exhaustion and the charmed and frightened conditions.

traits.name: Angelic Senses
traits.desc: The planetar can pinpoint the location of Aberrations, Celestials, Fiends, and Undead within 30 feet of it and knows if a place or object it can sense is consecrated or desecrated.

traits.name: Angelic Weapons
traits.desc: The planetar's weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 7d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Divine Awareness
traits.desc: The planetar knows if it hears a lie.

traits.name: Divine Protection
traits.desc: Aberrations, Celestials, Fiends, and Undead have disadvantage on attack rolls against the planetar.

traits.name: Immortal Nature
traits.desc: The planetar doesn't require food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The planetar has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Holy Burst
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 20, each enemy in a 20-foot-radius Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere centered on a point the planetar can see within 120 feet. Failure: 24 (7d6) Radiant damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The planetar makes three Radiant Sword attacks or uses Holy Burst twice.

actions.name: Radiant Sword
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 10 ft. 14 (2d6 + 7) Slashing damage plus 18 (4d8) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The planetar casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20):

- **At Will:** Detect Evil and Good
- **1/Day Each:** Commune, Control Weather, Dispel Evil and Good, Raise Dead

actions.name: Divine Aid
actions.desc: The planetar casts Cure Wounds, Invisibility, Lesser Restoration, or Remove Curse, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

traits.name: Divine Awareness
traits.desc: The planetar knows if it hears a lie.

traits.name: Exalted Restoration
traits.desc: If the planetar dies outside Mount Celestia, its body disappears, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in Mount Celestia.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The planetar has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
